event_note: Company release of 2026-10-21 (Business Wire, reposted by Earnings Whispers) sets the Q3 2026 call at 08:30 ET Wednesday 2026-11-11 with results 'issued in a press release prior to the call'. Session settled by the company's own pattern: the Q2 2026 8-K exhibit 99.1 is dated 2026-08-04 (baseline acceptance time amc) with the call at 08:30 ET on 2026-08-05, i.e. release after the close the evening before a morning call. So the Q3 release is most likely 2026-11-10 after the close (amc), with a bmo release on 11-11 the only alternative; either way the reaction lands inside the 11-10 close to 11-11 close window.
conviction_note: abs_move 14 (event-implied 13.15%, median past reaction 10.7%, hunters run small) times a weak up-lean (p_up 55): the company's >=$140m FY guide sits above a ~$133m street, a direct peer (Enovix) pre-announced a drone-led beat after Amprius last spoke, the CFO said Q3 was covered by open POs, and ~15.6% of shares are short into a stock 61% off its high. Against that: the CFO's own warning that supply binds 'particularly in Q4', a gross-margin bar that needs ~31% in H2 against 27% in Q2, and a name that sold a 12% revenue beat by 27% in May. Findings sum to +3.1 and the scaled number is +1.4. The gap is there because most of the positives depend on management reaffirming the guide, which I cannot see in advance.
bar: Q3 2026 revenue consensus about $35.8m (Benzinga, quoted by Earnings Whispers/Finviz preview 2026-11-03, https://finviz.com/news/414386/amprius-must-prove-its-second-half-ramp-as-stock-lags-its-raised-140-million-outlook) to $36.6m (Chartmill, via search snippet https://www.chartmill.com/stock/quote/AMPX/estimates), EPS -$0.01. That is two roughly agreeing sources. FY2026 street revenue about $133m, against a company guide of at least $140m, gross margin at least 28%, adjusted EBITDA at least $4m and net loss under $10m (Q2 8-K, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001899287/000189928726000056/ampx-2026x08x04x8kex991.htm). The company gave no Q3-specific guide. I sized the revenue read against $35.8m.
positioning_check: FINRA short interest 22,724,816 shares at the 2026-10-15 settlement, 3.81 days to cover, about 15.6% of shares outstanding. It has been flat at 22.1m-23.2m since August, down from a 28.0m peak on 2026-07-15 (https://equibles.com/stocks/ampx/shortinterest). The 10-30 settlement is not yet published. Baseline options: 25-delta skew +11.0 vol points (downside paid), ATM IV 183%, put/call open interest 0.08 (open interest is overwhelmingly calls), event-implied move 13.15%. Spot $8.98 is 60.8% below the 52-week high and 19% above the low. The stock is down about 32% since the Q2 report and set a 12-month low around $7.26-7.70 in mid-October. The crowded short and the call-heavy open interest set squeeze potential against the put skew.

findings.finding: The company's FY2026 guide of at least $140m revenue (raised twice, last on 2026-08-04) sits about $7m above the ~$133m street FY consensus. H1 was $62.6m, so the guide needs $77.4m in H2: about $41.6m in Q4 if Q3 prints the $35.8m consensus, against roughly $34.6m implied by the street's FY number. A reaffirmed $140m therefore reads as a Q4 about 20% above where the street sits. A cut to the low $130s only matches what the street already models.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 (2026-08-04): guide raised $130m to $140m and margin to 28%, stock +8.42% (baseline; Simply Wall St cites +23.4% over several days). Q4 2025 (2026-03-04): +18.65%. Q1 2026 (2026-05-06): revenue beat with guide raised but margin slipped, -27.4%.
findings.why_not_priced: If the market believed the guide, the street FY number would sit at or above $140m, not $133m. And the stock would not be down 32% since the guide was raised, trading below its 200-day average (~$13.4) and near a 12-month low. The price is discounting a guide cut, so a plain reaffirmation is not in it.
findings.independence: Company guide from the Q2 8-K, a different document: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001899287/000189928726000056/ampx-2026x08x04x8kex991.htm. Same CFO commentary source as the supply finding (allmind call summary), which argues the other way.

findings.finding: Q3 revenue visibility from company documents. On the Q2 call (2026-08-05) the CFO said open POs gave 'good visibility through Q3', with orders received and shipped inside the quarter as in the prior two quarters. Inventory rose $3.3m to $11.5m 'to support the Q3 ramp'. The 10-Q puts remaining performance obligations at $36.5m on 2026-06-30, all due within a year, which by itself roughly matches the $35.8m Q3 consensus. The $24m European drone order ships over about 2.5 quarters from Q2, roughly $9-10m a quarter. Together these point to Q3 revenue at or modestly above the bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Revenue beats have not reliably paid here. Q1 2026 revenue of $28.5m beat ~$25.3m consensus by 12% and the stock fell 27.4% on margin and EPS. Q2's beat came with a raise and rose 8.4%. Q3 2025 beat ($21.4m vs $17.5m) rose 13.1%.
findings.why_not_priced: The consensus of ~5% sequential growth already embeds a modest beat-free Q3. The reported-quarter line sits inside what the company guided, so most of it is priced. What is not obviously priced is that the RPO alone nearly covers the bar. If it were priced, the street would sit at $37-38m rather than $35.8m.
findings.independence: 10-Q RPO figure from a separate primary document: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001899287/000189928726000059/ampx-20260630.htm. Shares the call-summary source with the guidance and supply findings.

findings.finding: The CFO said on the Q2 call that supply is the main constraint 'particularly in Q4 and into next year'. Capacity is >2 GWh, about 12-15m cells a quarter. The US network has no pouch partner yet, the Fremont pilot line starts only in December 2026 and CAMINUS volume only in Q1 2027. That leaves the Q4 ramp the $140m guide needs, and any 2027 framing, exposed to contract-manufacturer output.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print turned on a supply-capped guide. The closest is Q1 2026 (-27.4%), when margin and EPS disappointed despite a revenue beat.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. It was said in public on the call, and the street's $133m FY figure may already reflect it. Some of it is not priced: if management quantifies a Q4 cap below the guide, the guide cut becomes explicit. Sized small, and shrunk further for the ~15.6% short interest.
findings.independence: Same call summary as the guidance finding, read in the opposite direction. Those two are one source and partly offset. Briefglance's preview lists CAMINUS timing as an open risk: https://briefglance.com/articles/amprius-q3-earnings-preview-the-asset-light-gamble-in-next-gen-batteries

findings.finding: On 2026-11-09 China's MOFCOM said it will keep suspending its October 2025 export controls until 2027-01-10. Those controls cover lithium-ion cells of 300 Wh/kg or more, the class SiCore falls in (Announcement 58; suspension under Announcement 70 was due to lapse 2026-11-10). This removes a cliff dated the day of the print. But the relief is only two months, and Amprius' own 10-Q flags these controls as a supply risk for its China contract manufacturers.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print turned on it.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: it was public on 11-09 and spot is $8.98 against $8.38 on 11-03. What is not priced is management's answer on the call about China-sourced cell supply after 2027-01-10. That could go either way, so it is sized near zero with a positive tilt for the removed immediate cliff.
findings.independence: 10-Q risk factor: enforcement 'suspended until at least November 2026', https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001899287/000189928726000059/ampx-20260630.htm. Chinaprospect notes the formal legal notice may lag: https://chinaprospect.com/china-export-controls-rare-earths-battery-materials/

findings.finding: Shipments to Ukraine were $10.4m in Q2 (31% of revenue) and $20.5m in H1 (10-Q), with EMEA at 68%. Since the company last spoke, Ukraine's drone budget came under stress: on 2026-09-25 Zelensky said drones for Jan-Mar must be ordered and paid in Oct-Nov. Then the EU disbursed EUR1.24bn (10-07) and EUR2.86bn (10-14) for Ukrainian-made drones, and Germany said on 10-04 it will fund tens of thousands of interceptor drones. Net, this supports Q4 orders from the largest end market.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Not separately disclosed before. The concentration figure comes from the 10-Q and has not been a headline line on a print.
findings.why_not_priced: This is a macro-to-company proxy that Amprius has not confirmed. The Ukraine share is in the 10-Q but is not in previews or wire copy. If the market had connected the EU drone tranches to Amprius' largest customer region, the drone-battery sell-off into October would not have taken the stock to a 12-month low. Sized small because it is a proxy and one region. The remaining ~69% of revenue (Europe ex-Ukraine, North America, APAC) also has to hold.

findings.finding: Direct peer Enovix pre-announced Q3 2026 revenue of $11.0m on 2026-10-12, above its $9-10m guide, with drone and defense about 70% of revenue. It reconfirmed on 2026-10-28 that its drone pipeline was up 48% to ~$150m and that POs received in early Q4 exceeded all of Q3 revenue, including a 100,000-unit dual-use drone order. That is a counterparty-level read on silicon-anode drone-cell demand published after Amprius last spoke.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No baseline history on peer read-through.
findings.why_not_priced: Amprius made a new 12-month low (~$7.3-7.7) in mid-October, after the Enovix pre-release. The market did not carry the peer's drone strength over to AMPX, and the street's $133m FY figure was not lifted toward the guide. Enovix is far smaller in drones and sells pouch cells into different customers, so this is a sector read and not a customer confirmation.
findings.independence: Enovix 8-K, a different company and document from all other findings. Also https://finviz.com/news/401240/enovix-q3-revenue-rises-38-to-11-million-exceeding-guidance-as-defence-demand-grows

findings.finding: Gross margin is the line this stock has sold on. The FY guide of at least 28% needs about 31% in H2 (Earnings Whispers arithmetic) against 27% in Q2, and Q2 was itself up from 20% in Q1. The CFO said H2 margin 'could have upside' but that the guide assumes at least 60% Europe and at least 60% pouch in the mix. A Q3 margin under ~29% would make the FY margin guide look unreachable.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026: margin fell from 24% to 20% and EPS missed, stock -27.4% despite a 12% revenue beat. Q2 2026: margin rose to 27% with a raise, stock +8.4%.
findings.why_not_priced: The bar is not visible in consensus EPS (-$0.01 is near break-even and could be hit on revenue alone). The 31% H2 requirement is arithmetic that only one preview spelled out. Sign uncertain and the range is wide. Shrunk because the short interest is crowded.
findings.independence: Company margin guide and Q2 margin from the 8-K: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001899287/000189928726000056/ampx-2026x08x04x8kex991.htm. Same EW preview as the guidance finding.

findings.finding: Amprius filed an S-3ASR automatic universal shelf on 2026-10-09 with no ATM agreement and no selling holders. Its $100m ATM was fully used and terminated in 2025, and none was drawn in 2026. Cash was $74.5m on 2026-06-30 after a $40.1m H1 operating outflow (including the $20m Colorado lease exit), and AR has swelled to $40.7m. A post-print offering is mechanically ready. What the money would buy: Fremont pilot line tools (40% installed), the in-kind share of the ~$100m acCELLerate line conversion (only ~$22m of the $75m DoW award obligated), and contract-manufacturing capacity the CFO says binds supply. Demand is corroborated by orders, the peer print and the guide, so the financing answer is 'funds visible demand': signed zero.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No offering has been announced alongside a print in the baseline.
findings.why_not_priced: The shelf is public but rarely read. An overnight deal after the print, at prices near the 12-month low, would land inside the window. The 10-Q states cash suffices for twelve months, and the use of funds is corroborated, so this is signed at zero with a negative tail in the range.
findings.independence: 10-Q liquidity and ATM status: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001899287/000189928726000059/ampx-20260630.htm. DoW funding detail: https://dronexl.co/2026/09/30/amprius-75m-drone-battery-grant-unfunded/

findings.finding: About 22.7m shares were short at 2026-10-15 (≈15.6% of shares outstanding, 3.8 days to cover), flat since August. Option open interest is 92% calls (put/call OI 0.08) while the 25-delta skew is +11 vol points. The stock is 61% below its high and down ~32% since the last print. Any reassurance on the guide meets a crowded short in a depressed stock.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Up moves after prints have been large: +34.6%, +18.7%, +13.1% and +8.4%, with the short interest over 15% through 2026.
findings.why_not_priced: The put skew says the option market leans to downside. The squeeze is a separate mechanism, conditional on the print, and the skew does not price it. If shorts had covered into the print, short interest would have fallen from its 22-23m plateau. It has not.
findings.independence: Baseline options block (skew, P/C OI), sealed separately. Short-interest trend corroborated by the search summary of FINRA data at https://curvedtrading.com/stocks/ampx/short-interest/

findings.finding: On 2026-09-23/28 Amprius signed a Project acCELLerate OTA for up to $75m from the Department of War (IBAS) to convert a Korean partner's US EV line to 12m drone cells a year by early 2028. About $22m is obligated and the majority is unfunded and milestone-based. The CEO framed it as about $150m of incremental annual revenue, a 2028 story that the call will likely carry into any 2027+ framing.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The announcement day rose about 10% (parameter.io headline). There is no print history on it.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: it was announced, traded on, and the stock has since fallen below the pre-announcement level. It is left in at a small size only because the call may add funding or timeline detail.

outside_window.finding: China's suspension of the 300 Wh/kg lithium-ion export controls now ends 2027-01-10. If it lapses, Amprius' China contract-manufactured SiCore cells would need export licences (Adamas expects more than two months of licensing).
Public and PIPE warrants (10.47m at $11.50/$12.50) expire 2027-09-14. Redemption triggers at $18/$20 are far above spot.

baseline_tension: The findings lean mildly up, against a +11 put skew and a stock in a downtrend, but in line with call-heavy open interest and a crowded short. The lean rests on a reaffirmation I cannot see, which is why p_up is only 55.
lessons_applied: Lesson 1 (a verified fact is not a predicted reaction): Q3 revenue-visibility finding cut from +1.0 to +0.7, because this name sold a 12% revenue beat by 27% in May

Lesson 4 (financing is a question): the S-3ASR shelf moved from -0.5 to 0.0 after asking what the money buys. It funds capacity the CFO says binds supply, corroborated by orders and the peer print. The negative tail stays in the range.
Lesson 7 (crowded short shrinks negatives): supply-constraint finding -1.0 to -0.7, margin finding -0.5 to -0.3, given ~15.6% of shares short
Lesson 6 (verify the bar): bar confirmed from two roughly agreeing estimate sources ($35.8m / $36.6m), so no cap applied
